risk_addressed: The archive had many prepared gates but no compact last-mile run sequence. This checklist makes the next human action concrete without letting a checklist authorize contact.
operator_role: human sender / archive steward outside the public release tree

critical_path.name: choose branch
critical_path.pass_condition: private signed record says no-send, defer, stop, or one exact reviewer-first send

critical_path.name: select private roots
critical_path.pass_condition: private roots exist outside release tree for sent copy, transport proof, raw inbound, classification notes, and sealed evidence

critical_path.name: refresh route facts
critical_path.pass_condition: public locator and route fit rechecked at send time and not expired

critical_path.name: recompute exact message hashes at send-time
critical_path.pass_condition: send-time body, .eml, subject, recipient, sender account, and no-attachment scope match signed authority

critical_path.name: send at most once or record no-send
critical_path.pass_condition: one-shot send window is open and exact no-attachment message is sent at most once, or a private no-send/defer/stop record is created

critical_path.name: capture transport outcome
critical_path.pass_condition: raw sent copy and delivery/failure evidence are preserved privately; delivery alone starts no response clock

critical_path.name: classify any inbound
critical_path.pass_condition: auto-ack, decline, referral, narrow yes, do-not-contact, private-data request, silence, or human response is classified before narration

critical_path.name: publish only a safe shell
critical_path.pass_condition: public statement reports no more than the classified outcome and never exposes raw private material

absolute_no_go_conditions: no private signature or expired private signature
route ledger expired or locator changed without renewal
private roots absent or inside public release tree
body or .eml hash differs from signed record
recipient, subject, sender account, attachments, or stage-two payload differ from signed record
counterparty says decline, do-not-contact, wrong route without referral, or requests raw private material before custody is ready
any operator wants to close A1-A6 by doctrine, registry, score, delivery metadata, auto-ack, silence, or narrative
no send-attempt transaction ledger with explicit pass/abort/not-reached classification
positive_progress_events: private signed one-shot send authority captured
private vault roots created outside the release tree
send-time locator recheck and exact message hash recompute completed
human response, decline, referral, narrow yes, or failed gate classified under the playbook
non_progress_events: having a green lint result only
next_real_action: complete a private signed no-send/defer/stop or one-shot send authority record; otherwise no-send remains binding
